result:
On an idle host, none of the 50 simultaneous export starts took longer than 2 s, in any of the three repetitions. The earlier over-2 s results (24 of 50 for DO-G, 48 of 50 for BE-S) were measured while the host was heavily loaded (load average 10.7–19.1) and did not recur here.

**How it was measured:** I ran the unchanged `deploy/load/export-proof.mjs` (2 s threshold) on the full load dataset. The generator was the same patched scratch copy DO-G and BE-S used. Each repetition got a freshly generated database and a fresh API and worker. The host was quiet throughout: load average 0.58, 0.75 and 0.92 before the three proofs and at most 1.02 after, with `nproc` 4. The workload and threshold were not changed.

| Repetition | One requester, 16 exports: start p50 / p95 / max | 50 simultaneous exports: start p50 / p95 / max | Starts over 2 s |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 89 / 251 / 251 ms | 1,088 / 1,286 / 1,288 ms | 0 of 66 |
| 2 | 78 / 254 / 254 ms | 1,108 / 1,294 / 1,305 ms | 0 of 66 |
| 3 | 81 / 236 / 236 ms | 1,267 / 1,572 / 1,579 ms | 0 of 66 |

- **Rest of the acceptance text:** in every repetition, all 66 exports returned a job ID, progress rose steadily to 100% and the job succeeded. The requester downloaded every file. Every other user with the same scope, and every AUD user, got 404 for both the job and the download. All 198 job IDs are listed in `summary.txt`.
- **The proof script still exits 1 in each repetition.** The cause is one assertion: transformation LOAD-T20 has no second user with the same scope to test against. BE-S and DO-G already reported this gap in the dataset; it is not a latency or access failure.
- **Margin:** latency grows with concurrency. 50 simultaneous starts take about 1.1–1.6 s, against under 0.26 s for one requester, so the worst case is 0.42 s under the limit. On a loaded host of this size the limit was missed before. Whether to move snapshot assembly into the worker is your decision; I'm only reporting the figures.

**Acceptance checks:**
- typecheck, build, lint, Prettier and the OpenAPI lint all exit 0.
- `pnpm test` exits 0 both with the locale unset and with C.UTF-8. It ran 2,801, 2,015 and 259 tests across its three Vitest runs, with 2 skips that were already there.
- `node tools/gates/validate.mjs --historical --stage DG5` exits 0.
- **Integration suite:** exit 0, 406 files, 4,119 tests passed, plus 1 skip and 2 todos that were already there. The first attempt was stopped by my tool's 40-minute limit for background commands, not by a test; 1,039 tests had passed and none failed by then. Its log is kept.

**Overrun:** waiting for that second integration run put me at about 2 h 27 min (13:51–16:18Z), past the ~2 h limit. I let it finish rather than hand back an unfinished required check.

**For you to decide or act on:**
- D-202 is not in `decisions.md` on this branch (the highest entry is D-201), so please record it.
- Two problems are still open: the LOAD-T20 gap in the dataset, and the tree's generator writing invalid UUIDs. All DG6 load figures, including these, come from the patched scratch copy of the generator.
- The evidence is in my handback folder, like the earlier proofs. Copy it to `docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG6/load/` if you want it next to DO-G's results.

No product code, test, contract, migration, dependency, pending-operation list or en/ar text was changed. Everything is left uncommitted.
